description: This is a source code file defining the OAuthServer class within the OrangeHRM project. It implements an OAuth 2.0 authorization server, initializing repositories, configuring grant types, and managing token TTLs.

classes.name: OAuthServer
classes.description: Implements OAuth 2.0 authorization server setup, repository initialization, and token lifetime management for the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes repositories and configuration values necessary for the OAuth server.

methods.name: getServer
methods.description: Returns an initialized AuthorizationServer instance, configuring grant types as needed.

methods.name: getAuthCodeTTL
methods.description: Retrieves the time-to-live for authorization codes.

methods.name: getRefreshTokenTTL
methods.description: Retrieves the time-to-live for refresh tokens.

methods.name: getAccessTokenTTL
methods.description: Retrieves the time-to-live for access tokens.
